news.headline: Technical Universities in Odisha Expand Semiconductor and Clean-Energy Research Labs
news.summary: Public engineering institutes across Odisha announced new interdisciplinary fabrication and power-systems laboratories for undergraduate and postgraduate students. The initiative connects campus projects directly with national R&D grants.

news.headline: ISRO Completes Key Gaganyaan Crew Module Propulsion Test Ahead of Orbital Mission
news.summary: Indian Space Research Organisation engineers successfully validated the service module propulsion system under simulated mission durations. The milestone clears a major hardware qualification gate for India's upcoming human spaceflight program.

news.headline: Open-Source Fellowships Open Applications for Undergraduate Student Contributors
news.summary: Major open-source foundations announced summer and winter mentorship cohorts covering systems programming, documentation, and technical writing. Selected students receive stipends and direct mentorship from project maintainers.

news.headline: Open-Weight Multimodal Models Reach Parity on Scientific Reasoning Benchmarks
news.summary: New open-weight frontier models demonstrated strong accuracy across university-level physics, chemistry, and coding evaluations. Researchers noted that smaller quantized versions can now run locally on university lab workstations.

news.headline: International Booker Prize Shortlist Spotlights Translated Regional Fiction
news.summary: Six works translated from five languages made this year's shortlist, highlighting independent presses and cross-cultural storytelling. Literary societies across universities have added the shortlisted translations to their reading circles.

news.headline: UN Sustainable Development Goals group for science, technology rejigged
news.summary: The group has been constituted even as the international community ramps up efforts to achieve the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development

news.headline: China’s LineShine retains top spot on list of world’s most powerful supercomputers
news.summary: The highest ranked Indian machine on the list is Shakti Cloud at number 35

news.summary: Popular titles like The Odyssey are being “sold & shipped by Best Buy."

news.summary: With MyMems , Wright says he wants to "turn the simulation inward."
